svg.title: About this repository: the portfolio is a single static page. No framework, no build step, no dependencies, no tracking. index.html is the whole site, with inline CSS and about 70 lines of vanilla JavaScript. assets holds the résumé PDF and the Open Graph image. assets/fonts holds self hosted Syne, Sora and DM Mono, so there is no third party font request. _redirects sends the legacy Netlify path to the home page, and .nojekyll tells GitHub Pages to serve assets as they are. Live at koundinya2003.github.io/Portfolio.
